class Box<C> { fun <T> bad(x:T, vararg items:T) { val alias=items; alias[0]=x } }

fun <T> mutate(items:Array<T>, value:T) { items[0]=value }
class Box<C> { fun <T> bad(x:T, vararg items:T) { mutate(items,x) } }

class Box<C> { fun <T> first(ignored:T, vararg items:C):C=items[0] }
fun bad():String=Box<String>().first(1,2)

class Box<C> { fun <T> first(vararg items:T):T=items[0] }
fun bad(x:IntArray):Int=Box<String>().first(*x)
